_comment: Entries for the What's new panel, newest first. Edit freely: date (YYYY-MM-DD), title and text. These are placeholders.

entries.title: What to buy this week
entries.text: Purchasing now opens on a weekly report: items to order, suggested quantities, order-by dates and what runs short before the next delivery.

entries.title: One-tap waste logging
entries.text: Kitchen teams can log waste with a single tap from the stock screen, and undo a mistaken tap.

entries.title: Invoice reconciliation
entries.text: Supplier invoices are compared with what was ordered and delivered, with every difference listed for review.
